timeline.summary: Linde India announced that its shareholding in Zenataris Renewable Energy Private Limited reduced from 27% to 19.18% due to further allotment of equity shares.
Linde India commenced commercial production at its new 1,450 TPD Air Separation Unit at Jindal Stainless Ltd. in Kalinganagar on 27 May 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹614.33 Cr (+3.8% YoY), net profit ₹77.45 Cr (-34.6% YoY).
